```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(luadtools)
```

This vignette shows an end-to-end TCGA-LUAD analysis using package functions.

## 1) Download and prepare TCGA-LUAD data

```{r download, eval = FALSE}
# Network-heavy: disable by default in vignette builds
se <- tcga_luad_download_prepare(
  sample_types = c("Primary Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal"),
  project = "TCGA-LUAD"
)
```

## 2) Differential expression analysis

```{r deseq, eval = FALSE}
out <- deseq2_tumor_vs_normal(se)
res <- out$res
vsd <- out$vsd
```

## 3) Visualizations

```{r plots, eval = FALSE}
plot_pca(vsd, group_col = "sample_type")
plot_volcano(res,
  title = "TCGA-LUAD: Tumor vs Normal",
  subtitle = "Biomarcadores transcriptómicos"
)
plot_topvar_heatmap(vsd, group = out$coldata$sample_type, top_n = 20)
```

## 4) KEGG enrichment

```{r kegg, eval = FALSE}
kegg <- kegg_enrichment_from_deseq(
  res,
  padj_cutoff = 0.05,
  lfc_cutoff = 1,
  direction = "up"
)

kegg$dotplot
kegg$barplot
```

## Notes

- Keep network-heavy operations disabled for automated checks.
- Consider local caching or project-level dependency management (`renv`) for reproducibility.
